meta.title: Quantum Aether PQ-TLS Index
meta.method: One public HTTPS host per institution; TLS handshakes on port 443 only (Chrome-like TLS 1.3 ClientHello offering X25519MLKEM768, then a standard handshake). No HTTP requests. Failed hosts retried once.

status_values.pq_hybrid: server selected an ML-KEM hybrid group (X25519MLKEM768 or SecP256r1MLKEM768)
status_values.classical: server answered with a classical key exchange only (incl. TLS 1.2-only)
status_values.not_measured: no complete TLS measurement from our vantage point (timeout, refused, handshake not completed); excluded from percentages
